d:
Tawang in Arunachal Pradesh was always so high on my bucket list and I finally made it here last month! It has been such an incredible journey with the most fulfilling return to a state that I’ve been to 4 times already. And everybody has showered nothing but love on me. For which I’m extremely grateful!
In today’s video, we are visiting Bumla Pass, Chakzam, Rice Bowl, Holy Waterfall and a few more local hot spots that are just so beautiful. Tawang feels like a natural marvel every step of the way and wherever you look. SO BEAUTIFUL!!
